Name: Flowery Stone
Author: AndrAla
Description:
[center][size=3]Since my other bin the Dark wood bin ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4760]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4760[/url] ) i decided to finish this bin also. Hopefully it fits well with Eemie's Medieval Modern Buildings, and to any of your tastes!

~~~~~~~~~[b]Instructions[/b]~~~~~~~~~~
Have both updated version of SMAPI, and Content Patcher!
[code][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url][/code]﻿
[code][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url][/code]
Simply download the .zip file . 
Unzip and place into your mods folder.
Once the config. file is created, (when the game is run)
you can change the options of having vines with flowers to having the stone bin. 
Enjoy your new bin !
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
~~~~~~~~~[b]Uninstall Mod[/b]~~~~~~~~
Simply delete mod from your mods folder
